posts.text:
At my lowest (so far, life is long!), AJ reached out immediately. 
Made sure I had his #. Followed up. 
Commissioned my first piece back.
 Told me (from memory here): "You may be scared of your byline, I'm not." 
That's what I needed to hear. 
Thanks for this @mcdermott: theguardian.com/media/ng-int…
